content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR IHBT Palampur Recruitment 2026?

rows.action: Download the application proforma annexed with Advertisement No. 15/ 2026 from the official CSIR IHBT website.
Fill up all columns of the application proforma very carefully in your own handwriting.
Scan the completely filled application form and convert it into a single PDF file.
Send the PDF to the specific e-mail ID mentioned against the chosen position code, with the e-mail subject as "Application for the position of ___________ (Position Code ___________)".

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR-IHBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application by the prescribed e-mail ID is 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR-IHBT Advertisement No. 15/2026?
faq.answer: A total of 07 positions are available across Project Associate PAT-I, Project Associate PAT-II, and Project Assistant-I categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for CSIR-IHBT Palampur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are not submitted through an online portal. Candidates must fill the application proforma by hand, scan it into a single PDF, and e-mail it to the address specified against their chosen position code.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CSIR-IHBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years as on 30 September 2026, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for CSIR-IHBT Palampur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee details are not mentioned in the official advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for CSIR-IHBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves screening of applications by a Screening Committee, followed by an interview conducted over Video Conferencing or MS Teams for recommended candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job at CSIR-IHBT?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary and co-terminus with the duration of the project or 6 years, whichever is earlier, and does not provide any right to regularization for a permanent CSIR post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Project Associate posts at CSIR-IHBT Palampur?
faq.answer: Project Associate PAT-I posts carry a stipend ranging from Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 31,000/- plus HRA, while Project Associate PAT-II posts carry Rs. 28,000/- to Rs. 35,000/- plus HRA, depending on the candidate's qualifications.
